title: wg: protocol-06 §5.1 which host serves a provider's directory
description: draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 §5.1 L1019-1023 (unchanged in the editor's copy as of 2026-11-02): the directory URL is discovered via the mimi-protocol-directory well-known URI, but no host is specified; providers are identified only by the MIMI URI authority (§3 L318-319). Not covered by any mimi-protocol issue (searched discovery, well-known, DNS, SRV, SVCB) or list thread (2023-24 discovery threads are about user/identifier discovery, not host lookup). Interop evidence: Haven assumes https://{provider_domain} (havenmessenger/interop#3); mimid uses a configured peer map (decision mimid-1wgh.17) and does not follow redirects (peer.rs redirect::Policy::none). Suggested fix: state https://<provider-domain>/.well-known/... with absolute directory URLs allowed elsewhere, say whether redirects are followed, optionally SVCB; say which name the TLS certificate carries. Draft issue text: session scratchpad wg-host-discovery.md. Posting needs Mark's OK.
